A '''family''' of [[Mugaari]] criminals lived on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The family was led by multiple people named Quetemoor: [[Quetemoor the Elder]], [[Quetemoor the Sub-Elder]], [[Quetemoor the Venerable]], and [[Quetemoor the Younger]]. The family had a peace agreement with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate, but constantly fought with other minor crime families within the Coruscant underworld.<ref name="CatCW" />
